summary.headline: Planetary Exaltation and Fall
summary.text: Mercury’s eastern and western elongation in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, with omens for kings, nobles, illness, ships, floods, and the lower classes. Chapter Five begins judgments on planetary exaltation, fall, detriment, apogee, and perigee, citing Birjandi’s commentary on the Twenty Chapters and introducing the Sun’s exaltation.
